en.topic_title: Four more mainland Chinese universities to admit Hong Kong students on DSE results from 2027
en.topic_summary:
Four more mainland higher education institutions have been added to a scheme allowing Hong Kong students to seek admission based on their DSE results from 2027, bringing the total number of participating schools to 169.
